newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Two S.Korean firms seek 23,500T of U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Two S.Korean firms seek 23,500T of U.S. wheat.

text.p: South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd have jointly invited tenders to buy a total of 23,500 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat by 2:00 p.m. (0500 GMT) on Friday, company officials said on Wednesday.
Of the total, Cheiljedang has invited tenders for 9,000 tonnes at basis prices over July futures on the U.S grain futures exchanges including the Chicago Board of Trade, they said.
Dongah Flour has invited the remaining 14,500 tonnes at fixed prices.
Shipment was set for June 1-30 to the southeastern port of Pusan.
